repositories.name: AutoWizard101

repositories.name: Wizard101_DanceBot

repositories.name: AaroneousAutomationSuite
repositories.decision: Inspect workflow concept only; reject whole kernel import. Missing asyncio import in reviewed workflow.

repositories.name: AndroidApp
repositories.decision: Defer mobile UI; unique background work/backoff is inspiration, Android WorkManager is not a Windows component.

repositories.name: Merlin
repositories.decision: Adapt routing explanations, fallback codes and policy version when a model adapter is added. No model/server import now.

repositories.name: MyFortress

repositories.name: Maelstrom
repositories.decision: Compare selectively; existing local MinigameCatalog counterpart makes wholesale copying redundant.

repositories.name: Library
repositories.decision: Adapt artifact/run identity and evidence references. Do not adopt compile/decompile-specific provenance or entire governance.

repositories.name: Workbench
repositories.decision: Apply digest-verification approach to existing fixtures with stricter validation. No verbatim source imported.

repositories.name: Aarogaming.github.io
repositories.decision: README-only site scaffold; no current reuse.

repositories.name: opencode
repositories.decision: Defer full coding-agent stack; outside gameplay/observer scope.

repositories.name: chatterbox
repositories.decision: Defer optional spoken coaching until needed; model/runtime dependencies are unnecessary now.

repositories.name: alexa-skills-kit-sdk-for-java
repositories.decision: Defer; Alexa/Java service integration does not solve current desktop needs.

repositories.name: Guild
repositories.decision: Adapt separation of observation, decision, execution and health. Do not copy permissive lifecycle transitions.

repositories.name: circuit-simulator
repositories.decision: No relevant implementation reuse; domain mismatch and restrictive original license terms.

repositories.name: aaroneous
repositories.decision: Keep previously reviewed resource-governor/adapter ideas; no Rust rewrite.

repositories.decision: Highest priority follow-on: attempt receipts, stale-result rejection and explicit recovery.
